(Published by Authority) PART III — LANDS
Land Acquisition Notices

No. 1930/10 – TUESDAY, SEPTEMBER 01, 2015
EXTRAORDINARY
THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT, (CHAPTER 460)
Notice under Section 7 My No. : MCUDP/LA/St. Seb. North (W-09)/14/01.
Land Ministry’s Ref. No.: 4/3/10/2013/LRB/524.

I, hereby give notice, under Sub-section (1) of section 7 of the Land Acquisition Act, as amended by the Land Acquisition (Amendment) Act. No. 28 of 1964, that the Government intends to acquire the land described below to be utilized for the renovation activities & construction of access road for the use of canal bank maintenance of St. Sebastian (North) Canal and construction of a pump house under the Metro Colombo Urban Development Project.

Description of the Land to be acquired: Allotments of land in total extent of 0.4078 hectares depicted as Lot No. 01 to No. 142 in the Preliminary Plan No. Co. 9549 dated 01.08.2015 prepared by the Survey General situated in the village called Kotahena in Ward No. 3, Mahawatta and Ward No. 6 Blumendal, in the Grama Niladhari Division of Mahawatta, Blumendal in the Divisional Secretary’s Division of in the Divisional Secretary’s Divisions of Colombo in Colombo District of Western Province and described as follows:
